tools.name: swop_search_identities

tools.name: swop_lookup_identity

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "commerce" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: swop_get_my_profile, swop_create_feed_post, swop_register_webhook, swop_get_product_link · Private data: swop_search_identities, swop_lookup_identity, swop_get_my_balances, swop_list_my_tokens, swop_add_link, swop_create_checkout, swop_register_webhook, swop_register_embed_origin, swop_get_store · Public sink: swop_get_my_profile, swop_create_feed_post, swop_create_product, swop_create_checkout, swop_list_webhooks, swop_register_webhook, swop_test_webhook, swop_remove_webhook, swop_get_product_link · Destructive: swop_remove_link, swop_remove_webhook, swop_remove_embed_origin, swop_feature_product.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: swop_get_my_profile, swop_create_feed_post, swop_register_webhook, swop_get_product_link · Private data: swop_search_identities, swop_lookup_identity, swop_get_my_balances, swop_list_my_tokens, swop_add_link, swop_create_checkout, swop_register_webhook, swop_register_embed_origin, swop_get_store · Public sink: swop_get_my_profile, swop_create_feed_post, swop_create_product, swop_create_checkout, swop_list_webhooks, swop_register_webhook, swop_test_webhook, swop_remove_webhook, swop_get_product_link · Destructive: swop_remove_link, swop_remove_webhook, swop_remove_embed_origin, swop_feature_product

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
